sourceBoundParaphrase.en: Within this practitioner tradition, the Expression Number concerns talents, abilities and the way a person works toward a broader life-direction potential. When its value is 1, initiative, autonomy, originality and self-direction are read as a talent-and-capability pattern; an imbalanced expression may involve impatience, over-control or excessive self-reliance.
